description: Tiny LUT-LM matched to vanilla MinimalGPT param count (~22M). Inherits exp327's recipe (RoPE, qkv_lut + additive v-branch, soft mode, noise_eps=0.002, bs=16) but every tph slashed and d_v reduced. Goal: see how far a parameter-matched LUT-LM can get against exp328 (vanilla+RoPE+bs=16 = 1.3882 @ 23.2 M). Architecture choices: E=64 (LUT-LM dual-stream), D=384 (match vanilla embedding), d_qk=64 (match vanilla head_dim), d_v=16 (very narrow attention output; H*d_v=96 vs vanilla's 384). LUT tphs: qkv_tph=8 NAP=6, v_tph=8 NAP=8, out_tph_per_layer=[32,32,16,16,16,16] NAP=8, residual_tph=8 NAP=6. Per-layer LUT params: qkv ~442K + v ~196K + out_proj (heavy-early) ~350K + residual_lut ~196K. Total ~22M.
